title: 10% off $30 and $50 Ultimate Birthday, Celebrate, Just For You, Thank You, Her and Teens Gift Cards @ Officeworks
body:
Deal: 10% off $30 and $50 Ultimate Birthday, Celebrate, Just For You, Thank You, Her and Teens Gift Cards @ Officeworks

[littlesoldier] Can this be double-dip? eg. using ultimate giftcard at officeworks to purchase giftcards?
[VantageXL] Their system stopped allowing it in 2023 and as far as I know that's still the case.
[z28] Is there a limit on how many gift cards can be used (for one transaction) at JBHifi ?
[33725] What about using Officework giftcard to buy? Will it work?
[A female dog] Can I be next in line to ask this same question
[kagarwni] Apparently , you cannot.
https://www.officeworks.com.au/information/policies/gift-car…
pt.5 : A Gift Card cannot be used to purchase another Gift Card (i.e., an Officeworks branded Gift Card, Partner Gift Card, Visa, Mastercard or EFTPOS Gift Card).
[daanish] A better use of gift card double dipping here is to walk in to Officeworks, buy one of the cards that can be used at Officeworks and then use that to complete the purchase of whatever you actually walked into Officeworks to buy.
An instant 10% discount for your purchase at the cost of 2 trips through the checkout queue.
[DealLlama67] If buying online, they would have to activate the card by ripping open the package to scan the long barcode and then ship it. What are the chances that someone would drain the value in the whole process?
[thousandsuns] There is a strip that comes off. Not sure where you found that they rip open the packages. It will stay intact.
[hotamericano] Just wondering, has anyone bought Ultimate Gift Cards from Officeworks, particularly through Click & Collect? I’ve only purchased them from Coles and Woolworths before, but I’m always a bit worried about fraud, especially since the cards are activated once purchased. Would Click & Collect be a safer option? Are the cards picked from separate stock rather than the gift card display?
[pgsheng] Bought online and CC last time with officeworks, local store very well (almost overly) protected the pick up parcel. No issue with the cards.
[Crowing] Paid with my EatClub cavier linked to Amex for extra 1% back via food credits :)
[dealsgrabber] Does it only work with credit cards linked to Eatclub or works if I have Good Food or Restaurant GC linked to Eatclub?
[Oct31Dec25] Can i use flybuys dollar to buy these gift cards?
[FrugalNotStingy] Can we still use these to buy Apple gift cards at JB Hi-Fi?
